title: Interaction Retention and Output-Likelihood Training in Parallel Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.28858v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel samplers such as masked diffusion language models generate several coordinates per step from conditional marginals and randomize which coordinates are generated together, so even exact conditionals return a distorted distribution. We give an exact local account of this distortion. Around any full-support product law, the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition, and its eigenvalues are retention probabilities: the probability that an interaction has a unique latest-revealed coordinate. This retention spectrum determines the exact frontier between output accuracy and conditional calibration, its regularization path, and the population response of finite-mixture likelihood training. For pairwise interactions it yields a sharp dichotomy. Under homogeneous retention, output-likelihood training is equivalent to a single context gain; heterogeneous retention opens correction directions beyon

translated_title: 并行采样中的交互保留与输出似然训练
translated_abstract: 像掩码扩散语言模型这样的并行采样器每一步从条件边缘分布中生成多个坐标，并随机化哪些坐标被一起生成，因此即使条件分布完全精确，其返回的分布也会产生失真。我们给出了这种失真的精确局部刻画。在任意具有完全支撑的乘积分布附近，采样器响应的Gram算子在交互分解下是对角的，其特征值即保留概率——也就是某个交互拥有唯一“最新揭示坐标”的概率。这一保留谱精确地划定了输出精度与条件校准之间的边界、其正则化路径，以及有限混合似然训练的总体响应。对于成对交互，它给出了一个严格的二分法：在同质保留条件下，输出似然训练等价于单个上下文增益；异质保留则开启了超越此范围的修正方向。
tldr: 该论文精确刻画了并行采样器的分布失真：采样器响应的Gram算子在交互分解下对角，其特征值（交互保留概率）决定了输出精度与条件校准的边界，并证明同质保留下输出似然训练仅等价于单一上下文增益，而异质保留可开启新的修正方向。
en_tdlr: This paper gives an exact local account of parallel sampler distortion, showing the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition with retention probabilities as eigenvalues, which determine the output-likelihood training frontier and reveal that homogeneous retention makes such training equivalent to a single context gain while heterogeneous retention unlocks new correction directions.
